talking about the graph traversal.

in the current level, then moves to the next level neighbors.
So this logic remains for finding the shortest path problem.
The only difference here is that we are going to create another variable, which is going to call the
previous, in which we are going to save the previous node to identify from which node we come to this
node.

going to start to explore the neighbor nodes.

Now if you look at this graph, you see that all nodes are visited.
So we are not going to continue to perform other operations for other nodes because we have marked them

So this means that the shortest path from A to B is A to B, and from A to D is direct path, and from
A to C is a direct path.
Now, if you want to go to from A to E, we need to go from A to B, then from A to E.
